hero.name: Janhavi Tupe
hero.subtitle: AIML | Full-Stack | Software | Explorer of the Cosmos
hero.briefingText: I'm an IT undergrad at SPPU trynna test the waters of the tech world. I dabbled in frontend development back in school, spent my first three years of college exploring AI/ML and Data Science, and now I'm diving into Software Development.  I love to explore a lot. I tend to resemble a butterfly the way I flutter from one interest to another.

paragraphs: I'm Janhavi, a final-year Information Technology engineering student and software developer who enjoys building things that sit at the intersection of engineering, data and intelligence.

My interests lie in backend engineering, distributed systems, applied machine learning and AI-powered applications. I enjoy working on problems that require more than just implementing a feature — understanding the underlying system, figuring out how its components interact, and designing solutions that are reliable, scalable and practical.
I'm constantly learning, building and questioning how things can be made better. For me, engineering is as much about understanding problems as it is about writing code.

projects.description: An autonomous, semi-sentient character that lives on your desktop. It watches what you're doing, has its own memory and moods, and speaks whenever it feels like it, with no fixed schedule. I'm designing the character art myself and using only free tools.

projects.title: Upstream
projects.description:
A single payments platform that combines four ideas, in priority order:
1. Payouts for open-source maintainers
2. Freelancer invoicing with automatic late-payment follow-ups (invoices go out without a separate approval step)
3. Subscriptions
4. Verified emergency crowdfunding
